article.story: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. -- — Trey Williams Jr. led Missouri State with 21 points, including the game-winning jump shot as time expired, and the Bears beat Drake 67-65 on Saturday. Williams also contributed five rebounds for the Bears (5-0). Melakih Cunningham added 10 points while going 4 of 6 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) while they also had seven rebounds. Andrej Acimovic had nine points and shot 3 for 12 (1 for 6 from 3-point range) and 2 of 5 from the free-throw line. Jon Carroll led the way for the Bulldogs (4-2) with 21 points and six rebounds. Dre Kindell added 10 points, five assists and three steals for Drake. Owen Larson also had nine points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
